newsitem.title: UK: LCE white sugar softer cuts losses by close.
newsitem.headline: LCE white sugar softer cuts losses by close.

text.p: White sugar futures continued to claw back earlier losses during Tuesday evening LCE trading, but still ended the session under fundamental pressure.

Traders said short-covering on the LCE helped contracts edge up slightly. October closed at $350.10, still down $2.40 a tonne from last Friday, but above the $349.00 low. Turnover was 3,098 contracts.

Earlier, further speculative sales in New York triggered some sell-stops against a background of a lack of offtake from end-users and news of a high Indian 1996/97 export authorization of one million tonnes.
The market also faced fundamental pressure from talk of Brazilian options activity in New York which suggested Brazil is a potential seller as well.
